title: Localization of a module at an element is base change to the localized ring
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $M$ an $A$-module and $f\in A$, and let $A_f$ and $M_f$ be the localizations of $A$ and of $M$ at $f$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away]. Then the map $M\otimes_AA_f\to M_f$, $m\otimes(a/f^e)\mapsto am/f^e$, is well defined and is an isomorphism of $A_f$-modules. In particular, for every $n\ge0$, $M_f$ is a free $A_f$-module of rank $n$ if and only if $M\otimes_AA_f$ is.
